svg.title: The Non-Performing Note Buyer's Operating Model
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-note-buyer-operating-model; chapter number: 11; title: The Non-Performing Note Buyer's Operating Model; subtitle: First-position paper, licensed servicing, borrower-first resolution; caption: The note buyer sits at the center of servicers, sourcing channels, diligence and borrower resolution, exiting through the borrower before foreclosure.; assumptions note: Headcount was not reported by practitioners; spoke KPIs restate reported rules and results only.; note: Sources: Colin Whitenack (gxiK62dzE34), PPR Capital Management (DEk2gIFHJiM), Fusion Notes (PXDW2SqUfMA), Sierra Davis (UimgP_cJydU), FIXnotes (lxjMbDIOEGw), Lauren Wells via Preferred Trust (nauUgmh1YZg).; chart type: org_architecture; center: role: Note Buyer; headcount: Not reported; boutique shops up to a $600-700M NPL desk; focus: First-position, secured single-family collateral with deep equity; spokes: role: Licensed Loan Servicer; type: Required partner; kpi: Boarded at closing or the deal is killed (Whitenack, PPR); role: Servicers and Foreclosure Attorneys; type: Off-market sourcing; kpi: Leads on portfolio sales and fund closings (Fusion Notes); role: Diligence on People, Property, Paperwork; type: Bid gate; kpi: Finished inside a 14 to 21 day window with BPO, insurance, taxes (Sierra Davis); role: Borrower Resolution; type: Rapport and intel; kpi: About 90% reperform, under 5% liquidated (Lauren Wells, 7e Investments)
